Summarise the following text in no more than 35 words:

The Pembrook Orchestra will perform all nine Beethoven symphonies over three evenings in July, conducted by Ana Ribeiro, who joined as music director last year. Tickets start at 18 pounds and a limited number of free seats will be given to students. The concerts will be held in the open-air amphitheatre, and if it rains they will move indoors to the town hall, which holds only 400 people. Ribeiro is the first woman to lead the orchestra in its 90-year history. The amphitheatre seats 1,500 and was renovated last year. Each evening will include three symphonies with a short interval, and a pre-concert talk about Beethoven's life will be given by a local professor an hour before each performance.
